caveats: Suit filed June 8, 2023 in US District Court (D. Mass.) by two child sexual abuse victims of ex-officer/union president Patrick Rose; defendants include City of Boston, BPD officials, DCF, and the police union. District court dismissed in 2024, but the First Circuit partially reversed and remanded in July 2025 and a renewed motion-to-dismiss hearing was set for Oct 27, 2025, so the case is active (ongoing). Rose pleaded guilty in 2022 to 21 counts of child rape/sexual assault (6 victims), sentenced to 10-13 years plus probation. Universal Hub source returned HTTP 403 and was skipped.
